mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, phone, password_hash, nickname, status, role, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{status}, #{role}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET phone = #{phone}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, nickname = #{nickname}, status = #{status}, role = #{role}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
